caption.en: A mitochondrion showing cellular respiration, with glucose and oxygen entering and carbon dioxide, water, and ATP energy being released.
caption.tl: Isang mitochondrion na nagpapakita ng cellular respiration, kung saan pumapasok ang glucose at oxygen at lumalabas ang carbon dioxide, tubig, at enerhiyang ATP.
caption.bis: Usa ka mitochondrion nagpakita sa cellular respiration, diin mosulod ang glucose ug oxygen ug mogawas ang carbon dioxide, tubig, ug enerhiyang ATP.
